create_DINOHead: create a DINOHead instance with specified input and output dimensions for self-supervised learning
build_DINOHead_with_bn: build a DINOHead with batch normalization enabled and custom hidden dimension size
run_DINOHead_forward: run the DINOHead forward pass on input tensor with optional last layer skip
init_DINOHead_weights: initialize DINOHead weights using truncated normal distribution with std 0.02
build_MLP_with_build_mlp: build an MLP with configurable layers, batch norm, and GELU activation via _build_mlp
